reason: A document the prov_documents strategy generates equals itself after a serialise and deserialise round trip in each of the five formats, with mention-bearing documents left out of the PROV-JSONLD row. The generated round-trip property is a protected class, and conformance caveat C2 in docs/reference/conformance.md says PROV-JSONLD has no Mention term.

A record that holds typed literals in any spelling, identified or not, equals itself after a round trip in each of the five formats, with the PROV-O inputs of caveats C10 and C11 left out. The generated round-trip property is a protected class, and docs/reference/conformance.md lists caveats C10 and C11 for PROV-O.

Two spellings of the same values give records that are equal from both sides and have equal hashes. The generated round-trip property is a protected class, and the equality of a literal in two spellings and its hash must agree (#527).
